title: Oozy Sweet Norwegian Coconut Hash
description: A paleo-friendly Norwegian dish featuring shredded coconut and sweet ingredients, perfect for a crowd-pleasing snack.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced apple to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the shredded coconut, honey, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring frequently, until the mixture is caramelized and gooey, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the sliced almonds and cook for an additional minute.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool slightly.
Serve the oozy sweet Norwegian coconut hash warm, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
